targetAudience.title: This is for you if…
targetAudience.subtitle: If you recognize yourself in these daily struggles, you are not alone — and you do not have to live like this.

points.title: Want your old energetic self back
points.description: You remember being energetic, fun, and confident, and you want that person back without quitting your job.

points.title: Sunday evening dread
points.description: Your Sunday evenings are ruined because your mind is already sitting in Monday’s meetings.

points.title: Waking up exhausted
points.description: You wake up tired, even after 7 hours of sleep, and need two cups of chai or coffee just to feel human.

points.title: Chronic physical tension
points.description: Your neck is stiff, your shoulders feel like stone, and your lower back aches by 4 PM. You can’t remember the last time your body felt light.

points.title: Nighttime brain overdrive
points.description: You close your laptop at 9 PM, but your brain doesn’t. You lie in bed replaying conversations, pending tasks, and “what will my manager think.”

points.title: Tried everything but it returns
points.description: You’ve done gym, diets, yoga, meditation, breathing routines, webinars. But anxiety keeps returning. Palpitations. Chest tightness. Sleepless nights. It just won’t stop.

points.title: Disconnected from loved ones
points.description: You’re missing life — moments with people you love. Trapped in fear, overthinking, and anxiety.

points.title: Suffering silently in solitude
points.description: Everyone sees you as the strong, sorted one, so you have no one to vent to. You just keep it all inside.

methodology.title: Introducing: The 6-axis psycho-somatic reset
methodology.subtitle: A 90-day guided program that finds the real reason behind your stress, anxiety, and exhaustion, and resets your mind and body from the root, without quitting your job or living at the gym.

steps.title: Step 1: The root cause scan
steps.subtitle: It starts with your root cause analysis
steps.description: Before a single exercise, we build your personal report across 11 areas, showing where your tension and anxiety start:

highlights.label: Triggers
highlights.desc: Sunday nights, appraisals, the 11 PM replay

highlights.label: Posture
highlights.desc: Years of laptop hunching & collapsed breathing

highlights.label: Sleep
highlights.desc: Late nights, 3 AM wake-ups, phone in bed

highlights.label: Habits
highlights.desc: Caffeine spikes, blue screens, late heavy dinners

highlights.label: Blood markers
highlights.desc: Nutrition & metabolic gaps silently draining energy

steps.title: Step 2: The dopamine & gut reset
steps.subtitle: Repairing your second brain & cravings
steps.description: Your mind-gut coach targets what keeps you on edge: the 3 PM coffee crash, late dinners, and 1 AM mindless phone scrolling.
keyPoints: These habits aren’t a discipline problem — your brain is simply chasing quick relief.
You’ll make small, office-friendly swaps with zero 6 AM meal prep and no giving up everything you love.
Your energy steadies throughout high-pressure work days, and relentless sugar/caffeine cravings fade away naturally.

steps.title: Step 3: The 6-axis body unlock
steps.subtitle: Releasing stored stress and chronic tension
steps.description: Your somatic reset coach releases years of stored stress: the hunched posture, locked shoulders, and tight chest before every team review.
keyPoints: Combines 6-direction spinal movements, Bhramari pranayama, 4-7-8 vagus nerve breathing, and restorative Yoga Nidra customized for your body.
Requires just 10 minutes a day, plus 2-minute discreet desk resets you can do between Zoom calls.
Within weeks, your autonomic nervous system finally switches from ‘fight-or-flight’ to rest, and your body stops bracing all day.

steps.title: Step 4: The habit lock-in & accountability protocol
steps.subtitle: Permanent calm as your default baseline
steps.description: Most wellness programs fail the moment work gets busy. That’s why your accountability coach checks in daily on your sleep, movement, nutrition, and mood.
keyPoints: Guided somatic journaling helps you pinpoint mental loops like ‘I keep replaying difficult conversations in my head.’
You’ll build a customized personal SOS plan so you know the exact 90-second protocol to run when panic or acute anger strikes.
We measure your GAD-7 score on day 1, day 21, day 45 and day 90, so you can see the change.
By Day 90, calm stops being something you desperately chase. It becomes your effortless daily default.

faqs.question: Do I need to take pills, medications, or expensive supplements?
faqs.answer: No. The entire methodology is 100% natural and drug-free. We use targeted somatic resets, spinal realignment, vagal nerve stimulation, circadian rhythm corrections, and practical dietary adjustments. But, if your doctor has prescribed medication, keep taking it. Any change to it is a decision for you and your doctor.

faqs.question: I have an extremely busy work schedule. Can I really do this?
faqs.answer: Yes. It is built for IT professionals with full calendars. The core practice is 10 minutes a day, plus 2-minute desk resets between calls. With journaling and your daily check-in, plan for 20 to 30 minutes in total, and one private live session a week.

faqs.question: What happens during the free Anxiety-Breakdown Consultation?
faqs.answer: It is a private 30 to 45 minute call with Abhijit. You get your current anxiety score, the two or three root causes driving your anxiety, one breathing reset you can use the same day, and a clear picture of what your 90 days would look like.

faqs.question: What is the guarantee?
faqs.answer: We stand 100% behind the 6-Axis Method. If you follow your customized daily protocols and don’t see a significant measurable improvement in your Anxiety & Mental Health Score in 90 days, we continue coaching you free of charge until you achieve the promised transformation.

faqs.question: Are the sessions live or recorded?
faqs.answer: Both. You get one private live session with Abhijit every week on Zoom, plus recorded sessions to practise with between calls.

faqs.question: I’ve already tried yoga and meditation. Why would this work?
faqs.answer: What you tried was a technique on its own. This starts by finding your cause in the Root Cause Scan. Then it works on body, sleep, gut and habits together, and a coach checks in with you every day.
